identity.title: Standard Air Contaminant Discharge Permit
identity.issuer: State of Oregon Department of Environmental Quality, Northwest Region

scan.summary: This is an air quality permit issued by Oregon DEQ authorizing Cascade Specialty Chemicals to operate two packed-bed wet scrubbers and four solvent storage tanks with carbon adsorption control at its Portland facility. The permit sets operating conditions, monitoring requirements, and reporting obligations. The permit itself is the agency's document with no gaps to fix; the owner's task is to meet its conditions and renew before expiry.
scan.freshness_note: Permit issued September 1, 2021 and expires November 15, 2026. Today is September 25, 2026. This permit is within 52 days of expiry. The renewal application deadline of July 18, 2026 (120 days before expiry) has passed. If a timely renewal application was not submitted by that date, operation after November 15, 2026 without a renewed permit is a violation. Request confirmation that a renewal application was submitted on or before July 18, 2026.
